_about: Shared fallback treatment for any color property no service rule explicitly touched: compresses fills/lines into Sol's light pastel range instead of leaving them at Esri's original saturation. Mirrors shadow's fallback.json but with the fill/line/circle band flipped toward high lightness (a light basemap) instead of low - text stays a similarly muted mid-gray either way, since label text needs to read dark against ANY background lightness.
